Managing research files

Research projects can quickly accumulate raw data, cleaned datasets, scripts, documents, figures, and intermediate outputs. A clear folder structure helps prevent confusion between original files and files created during analysis.

File names should be descriptive and consistent. Important files should also be backed up and changes should be tracked so that earlier versions can be recovered when necessary.
